title: Lesson Desk
oneLine: An AI lesson builder for a physics professor. A one-line request comes back as a 90-minute lesson grounded in the course textbook: slides, a group activity, a worksheet with a page-cited answer key, and two shuffled test versions.

specs.Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Claude API, Zod, Python (PyMuPDF), Cloudflare Workers, D1

intake.question: What number can you put on it?
intake.answer: A Python pipeline splits the textbook PDFs by chapter, then extracts and indexes 1,119 figures, with pixel-level verification.

intake.question: What did you decide, and what did you reject?
intake.answer: Generation runs in stages: route, plan, then parallel generation. Outputs are structured and schema-validated, a sanitization step rejects invented figure references, and student names never reach the model.
